up: List all approved drugs (max_phase = 4) where the mechanism of action is classified as an activator. For each drug, provide the compound name, the chemical structure (canonical SMILES), the mechanism of action description, and the target information (target name).
sql:
SELECT
  md.pref_name AS compound_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  dm.mechanism_of_action,
  td.pref_name AS target_name
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  md.max_phase = 4
  AND dm.action_type = 'ACTIVATOR';
